Volunteers take a shelter dog out for the day (walks, car rides, pet store, home) after picking a suitable dog with staff; the separate Holiday Sleepover page (foster application required) still shows only 2025-26 dates, so confirm the 2026 holiday schedule with the shelter. Shelter at 5694 Burbank Rd, Wooster.
